message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing progress: %s / %s s (Hoanna event: +%s per second)
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结进度：%s / %s 秒（海纳尔天灾中，每秒 +%s）

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the shell is incomplete.
Condensing paused: nothing condenses in this dimension.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：这个维度里凝不出矩阵。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the shell has %s Magic Plating and Pale Plating blocks; it needs at least %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：外壳里魔力护板、淡青护板一共 %s 块，至少要 %s 块。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the shell needs an Enrichment Chamber Stabilizer.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：外壳上要砌一块富集仓稳定器。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the chunks the shell spans aren't fully loaded yet.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：外壳所在的区块还没加载全。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: there is no MRUCU inside the chamber.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：仓里没有 MRU 聚集体。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the MRUCU inside holds %s MRU; it needs at least %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：仓里的聚集体存着 %s MRU，至少要 %s。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the chamber stores %s MRU; it needs at least %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：仓里存着 %s MRU，至少要 %s。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the chamber's balance is %s; it has to sit between %s and %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：仓的平衡值是 %s，要在 %s 到 %s 之间。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing: the chamber is pure, so the MRUCU will turn into a Condensed Matrix.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 正在凝结：仓是纯净的，聚集体会凝成一个凝结矩阵。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the Condensed Matrices inside the chamber are already a full stack. Open up a shell block and take them out, and it carries on.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：仓里的凝结矩阵满一组了，拆开一块外壳拿出来就接着凝结。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the Condensed Matrix was stopped from appearing in the chamber. The MRUCU and the stored MRU are untouched, and it tries again every second.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：凝结矩阵没能出现在仓里，被拦下了。聚集体和仓里的 MRU 都没动，每秒再试一次。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: The MRUCU in the Enrichment Chamber condensed into a %s, which is lying inside. Open up one shell block to fetch it, then put the block back.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 富集仓里的聚集体凝成了一个%s，就在仓里。拆开一块外壳进去拿，再补上。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing progress %s / %s s is kept; it resumes once the shell is fixed.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结进度 %s / %s 秒还留着，外壳补好就接着走。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.condensed_matrix.en: Forms inside an Enrichment Chamber that holds an MRUCU at a balance of %s–%s
tooltip.essentialcraft5.condensed_matrix.zh: 关着聚集体、平衡值在 %s~%s 的富集仓里慢慢凝出来

tooltip.essentialcraft5.condensed_matrix.en: Offered at the Matrix Crucible to break through matrix ranks
tooltip.essentialcraft5.condensed_matrix.zh: 在矩阵淬炼台突破矩阵阶时当祭品
